meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 模式,为 NanoClaw 群搭建常驻 wiki:建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 文件夹、初始 index.md 与 log.md、维护用技能文件,并在群设置写入 wiki 说明;多个文件会逐个处理,不批量总结。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base”等关键词,或要求给 NanoClaw 群添加常驻知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库。
say.note: Claude 会开始搭建 wiki 的文件夹和配置文件。

say.text: 我要给群建一个产品文档 wiki,支持 PDF 和链接。
say.note: 它会和你确认领域和来源类型,再生成配置。

say.text: 给 wiki 群安排每周一次健康检查。
say.note: 它会询问检查周期并安排定时任务。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki in a NanoClaw group per Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, initial index.md and log.md, a maintenance skill file, and adds a wiki section to the group settings. Multiple files are processed one by one, not batched.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", etc., or ask to add a persistent knowledge base to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group.
say_en.note: Claude starts building the wiki folders and configuration.

say_en.text: I want a wiki for product docs that supports PDFs and links.
say_en.note: It confirms the topic and source types, then generates config.

say_en.text: Set up a weekly health check for the wiki group.
say_en.note: It asks about the check interval and schedules the task.
